Madhya Pradesh CM visits school unannounced, interacts with students

Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Mohan Yadav halted his convoy unexpectedly to visit a school. He engaged in conversation with the students, inquiring about their studies. The CM participated in the school's prayer assembly and interacted informally with the children, whose faces lit up upon seeing him.
